description.description:
Problem summary

An iOS application may receive duplicate notifications for the same event. Given a list of notification IDs, count how many notifications are duplicates. An ID is considered a duplicate if it has appeared previously in the list.


Input format

A single line containing an integer N, followed by N integers representing notification IDs.


Output format

Print the total number of duplicate notifications.


Constraints

  • 1≤N≤1051 \le N \le 10^5
  • 1≤N≤105
  • 1≤ID≤1091 \le ID \le 10^9
  • 1≤ID≤109

code.body: # Enter your code here. Read input from STDIN. Print output to STDOUT
; Enter your code here. Read input from STDIN. Print output to STDOUT

.data
prompt: .asciiz "Enter N: "
result_msg: .asciiz "Duplicate count: "
newline: .asciiz "\n"
ids: .space 400000

.text
.globl main

main:
    # Read N
    li $v0, 5
    syscall
    move $s0, $v0          # N

    la $s1, ids             # Array base address
    li $t0, 0               # i = 0

read_loop:
    beq $t0, $s0, count_start
    li $v0, 5
    syscall
    sll $t1, $t0, 2
    add $t2, $s1, $t1
    sw $v0, 0($t2)
    addi $t0, $t0, 1
    j read_loop

count_start:
    li $s2, 0               # duplicate count
    li $t0, 0               # i = 0

outer_loop:
    beq $t0, $s0, print_result
    sll $t1, $t0, 2
    add $t2, $s1, $t1
    lw $t3, 0($t2)          # current ID

    li $t4, 0               # j = 0

inner_loop:
    beq $t4, $t0, next_i
    sll $t5, $t4, 2
    add $t6, $s1, $t5
    lw $t7, 0($t6)

    beq $t3, $t7, found_duplicate
    addi $t4, $t4, 1
    j inner_loop

found_duplicate:
    addi $s2, $s2, 1
    j next_i

next_i:
    addi $t0, $t0, 1
    j outer_loop

print_result:
    move $a0, $s2
    li $v0, 1
    syscall

    li $v0, 10
    syscall
